mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation (PAYEMS) indicates improving economic conditions and corporate hiring, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 8.5%, it signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as businesses expand and consumer spending rises.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 8.5%, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and fall in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a deteriorating economy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession fears.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5%), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) signals inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as the Fed is expected to raise rates further.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 650,000 units, it signals a strengthening housing market and broader economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 650.0, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in less than 40% of months when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0, it signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 95.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates increasing household spending and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS growth is positive.
